item.title: Welcome Note from the Author
item.description: Welcome to Docs That Speak — a portfolio and knowledge space by Jyoti Kiran.
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to Docs That Speak — a portfolio and knowledge space by Jyoti Kiran.

I'm a Senior Technical Writer and Lead Content Designer with 8+ years of experience turning complex products into clear, scalable documentation experiences.

This site is where my docs come alive — from API references to content strategy, developer portals to UX writing. Everything here is built the way I believe documentation should be: structured, purposeful, and human.

Thanks for stopping by. Explore the chapters, read the posts, and feel free to connect on LinkedIn.

— Jyoti
